candidate_reports.remark: NM National Guard reports a swift water rescue was performed near the intersection of County Road A20 and Paco Road. 2 occupants were rescued from the top of a vehicle. Time estimated via social media post and accompanying pictures.
ASOS station KRTN Raton Crews Airport.
Mesonet station SWCN5 SW Clayton.

Mesonet station WSM39 Shist (WSMR).

Delayed Report: River flooding along the Rio Puerco reached minor flood stage_ flooding Ramon Lopez Road and its access to the small town of San Francisco_ NM_ isolating 12 homes there. Potholes and sinkholes were also reported from the flooding.
Mesonet station WSM14 Oscura Range Camp (WSMR).
Mesonet station WSM43 Little Burro (WSMR).
Delayed LSR. Kirtland AFB.
Mesonet station CW3827 Nogal 5 NW.
Mesonet station WSM10 North Oscura Peak (WSMR).
Mesonet station WSM40 Mine (WSMR).
Mesonet station WSM39 Shist (WSMR).
A video shared on social media by a broadcast meteorologist shows floodwaters overflowing an arroyo and crossing County Road 23 near Haystack_ New Mexico.
Flowing water of unknown depth over highway 605 at MM 10. Video from Fire/Rescue in Slack.
NM DOT reported NM 539 b/w MM 0 to 5 due to standing water on the roadway.
Lots of small hail also observed from severe thunderstorm.
Delayed Report: Quarter size hail from COOP observer in Cubero.
Flooding in Bluewater Acres_ including 8 homes that were inundated and damaged with water.
Reports of street flooding in multiple places in downtown Gallup.
Street flooding in Grants at 2nd Street and also along Mesa Blvd.
Flash flooding is occurring along Largo Wash and Gobernador Canyon around Blanco and Archuleta. Evacuations are underway at several residences in the area.
NM DOT reported NM 118 closed at MM 33 near Wingate due to water over the roadway.
NMDOT reported NM124 closed at MM 18-19 with water over the roadway. A nearby COOP observer also shared reports of roads closed in the Cubero area from flooding along the Rio San Jose.

Multiple evacuations ongoing along the San Juan River due to flooding. As many as 1500 homes and buildings are estimated to be impacted by flooding. Over 60 water rescues are estimated to have taken place_ primarily between Farmington and Bloomfield since Thursday afternoon.
Bridge on 371 into Bloomfield closed due to water on the bridge from San Juan River.
West Chaco Bridge over Animas River in Aztec overtopped and closed.
NM DOT reported NM 371 closed b/w MM 103 and 107 due to standing water on the roadway. The report also stated that flooding was over the bridge.
Resident in vacation home in canyon west of Rio Chama reports road too muddy and washed out to travel on.

The NM Dept. of Homeland Security relayed a report from the field of river flooding along the Rio San Jose where it crosses I-40 just outside of Laguna. The river was 100 yds either side out of its banks_ impacting farm land.
Drone footage shared by KRQE showed large areas of water flooding streets and properties in Grants near Nimitz Drive and East Sargeant Street. Time estimated.
significant flash flooding observed with hail storm along U.S. 550.
*** 1 FATAL *** 1 adult male swept away in truck in low water crossing.
County Road 352 was washed out with mudslide and boulders. Residents above this location were cut off due to road damage. Time is a very rough estimate based on rainfall timing and nearby reports.
Bridge over San Juan River on HWY 64 in Shiprock is closed due to water overtopping as the river exceeded 21' in this location.
Farmingon Glade Arroyo overflowed its banks and impacted several homes along the arroyo.
FD reports culverts getting ripped out of road from rain coming off the foothills on the north side of Farmington.
N36 closed from junction of NM 371 on. Mud and Boulders in road.
NM 539 closed due to flooding.
Minor damage to a house_ trees down_ garage door blown in_ and shed damaged.
Flash flooding has impacted first floor of Sky City Casino. Attendees have evacuated to second floor. EM is working to open a shelter.
Water over the road at Frost Road and Broken Arrow. Arroyo out of its banks.
Magado Creek is out of it's banks and crossing E Deer Trail Road. E Deer Trail road is impassible.
I 40 WB and EB closed from MM 102 to 108 due to flooding over the interstate.
NM DOT reported NM 246 closed at MM11 due to standing water over the roadway from flash flooding.

A tornado developed in the Via Caballero neighborhood in the south central portion of Santa Fe just north of I-25. The tornado traveled northward for approximately 1.4 miles_ terminating near the College of Santa Fe. Much of the damage was along Rancho Siringo and Camino Chueco Roads. Damage included broken power poles_ uprooted or damaged trees_ damage to roofs. Ten homes sustained damaged. This tornado has been given a preliminary rating of EF-1_ pending additional information.
Dime to quarter size hail.
A large mature tree_ with a 1-2' trunk_ was uprooted. A branch burst through a window of a residence.
Cars stranded on NM-344 near Hawks Lane.
Several pics and video of a tornado near Table Mesa in open land on social media. No damage reported. The period of the Tornado report was 8 minutes.
Emergency manager confirmed brief tornado but remained in open fields with no damage reported.
Quarter to half dollar size hail.
Bridge on Marble quarry road over Rio Puerco collapsed due to flood damage.
*** 1 FATAL_ 2 INJ *** 1 adult female_ 1 adult male and one infant in silver hatchback swept away while going through low water crossing. Adult male and infant successfully rescued.
US 60 EB and WB closed due to flooding from Rio Puerco between Bernardo and junction of 47.
NM DOT reported U.S. Highway 60 closed at MM 166 just east of Bernardo due to flooding in both directions.
Penny hail along U.S. 285 at MM121.
NM DOT reported U.S. Hwy 70 closed 7 miles west of Roswell due to standing water over the roadway.
One person stranded on Roman Lopez road in mud and water_ requiring rescue.
15 people required water rescue. As of 1530 pm one person still missing. Others recovered successfully.
Multiple residential structures in Highland Meadows flooded from over flow from Rio San Jose.
Portions of Old Route 66 in Laguna Pueblo washed out by Rio San Jose.
*** 1 FATAL *** 1 adult female swept away in truck in early hours. SW crews performed recovery at 1600.
Old Highway 60 near Bernardo bridge overtopped. Old (disused) trestle bridge overtopped over Rio Puerco. Road closed for safety.

Delayed report from Tuesday Night. Time estimated. Levee breach forced evacuations in Socorro County in the Escondida and Pueblito communities. Several roads are impassable_ including Bosquecito Road_ Quebradas Road_ and NM Road 380 near San Pedro. 9 rescues have occurred in the area and 31 homes have been evacuated.
